One of three Heritage London Planetrees (396, 314, 321) in a small pocket park; a genuine compact ensemble like the Eliot Hawthorns, but 3.5km north of the downtown cluster this pass prioritised. Good candidate for a future 'Overlook' mini-walk together with the Northern Red Oak at nearby Patton Square (por-list did not include either).

CONFIRMED ALIVE AND CURRENT: this exact tree (Patton Square Park, 5340 N Interstate Ave) is one of the 12 trees NEWLY designated as a City Heritage Tree in the City of Portland's 2026 ordinance (https://www.portland.gov/council/documents/ordinance/2026-heritage-trees), so its live status is unusually well confirmed. Not selected for the 10 only because it sits 4.6km from the downtown cluster, isolated from the other Overlook candidates' immediate area by about 1km. Strong candidate for a future Overlook-area walk.
